finding: The standard-app entitlement check asserted the app-group value but not the com.apple.security.application-groups key, allowing a malformed dictionary with the value under another key to satisfy a substring check.
preserved_requirement: The actual exported app must contain the production app group under the application-groups entitlement key and must not contain the restricted Endpoint Security key.
repair: Require both exact entitlement key and group value in the decoded codesign entitlement plist.
